class.name: ObservableProperty
class.brief_description: A single observable value that emits a signal when changed.
class.description:
ObservableProperty wraps a single [Variant] value and emits [signal value_changed] whenever [method set_value] is called with a different value. Used internally by [ViewModel]; can also be used standalone.
Subscriptions are automatically disconnected when the ObservableProperty is freed (via [method ViewModel.dispose] or [RefCounted] lifecycle).

method.name: set_value
method.description: Sets the value. If different from the current value, emits [signal value_changed] and notifies subscribers.

method.name: subscribe
method.description: Subscribes a callback to value changes. The callback receives the new value.

signal.name: value_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the value changes. The new value is passed as [param value].
